purpose: Provide a compact, cryptographically bound projection of the canonical taste cache so structural validation and mechanical cache-hit checks do not require loading verbose evidence for every cached entry.

stage_04_header_fast_path_accept_only_if: index source_cache.path equals canonical cache path
index source_cache.blob_sha equals current Git blob SHA of canonical cache
index source_cache.size_bytes equals current repository size of canonical cache
index profile_blob_sha equals current canonical profile Git blob SHA
index taste_model_version equals canonical policy taste model version
trust_model.stage_04_attestation_basis: The generator parses the full canonical cache, computes len(entries), verifies declared entry_count and every required entry field, and only then emits the index bound to the exact source Git blob SHA and byte size. A matching source blob therefore makes those structural assertions applicable to that exact immutable cache object.
stage_07_full_index_accept_only_if_all: all stage_04 header fast-path checks pass
index index_entry_count equals actual len(index.entries) after the compact index is loaded
every compact map key is an exact candidate key representation
every compact entry has exactly the declared entry_fields shape

diagnostic_usage.stage_04: Read only repository metadata for the canonical cache plus the compact index header. A valid exact source-blob binding may carry forward the generator's structural attestation without loading verbose canonical entries or the full compact entry map.
diagnostic_usage.stage_07: Load the compact index entries, verify its actual entry count and shape, then use them for exact-key/profile/model/fingerprint mechanical comparison against current price-blind feed fingerprints.
full_cache_load_when: index is absent or invalid and fallback is attempted
a true cache miss must be merged and persisted
specific verbose evidence is needed for debugging
